svg.title: Governed ingestion and analytics topology
svg.desc: Topology showing partner files, database changes, and telemetry feeding Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, Synapse serverless SQL, and monitoring.

g.aria-label: scheduled and incremental ingestion: sources to factory
secretless linked services: identity to factory
idempotent zone writes: factory to lake
governed serverless queries: lake to synapse
pipeline and lineage telemetry: factory to operations
query and spend telemetry: synapse to operations
Service node: Files database changes telemetry

svg.text: Data Factory coordinates idempotent ingestion through managed identity before Synapse queries curated lake zones.
